style: Semi-realistic hand-painted visual novel, portrait 9:16, matching existing Belgrade backgrounds. No large foreground people, no readable signs, no logos. TV-safe street scenery only.

assets.prompt: Old Zemun cobbled street: low pastel houses, red tile roofs, a small church dome on the hill. Empty center for a sprite.
The Millennium Tower on Gardoš hill in Zemun: beige stone lookout above red roofs, the Danube beyond. Empty path in front.
Zemun quay on the Danube: promenade, restaurant barges with plain umbrellas, the hill and tower in the distance. No splav nightclub boats.
